selection_rule: Benchmark.load(n, seed): seeded uniform subsample without replacement, returned in dataset order. MMLU and ARC-style multiple choice keep the subject-stratified round-robin draw where the benchmark defines one; BoolQ draws label-balanced (equal Yes/No) rather than at its natural 62/38 rate. Where a benchmark has preserved ids, those are carried verbatim and only the remainder is drawn, from the complement, under the same seed.
